findings.statement: D_SYMMETRIC_MARGINALS is scalar-exact on all three hard carriers, so absolute owner labels D0 versus D1 are unnecessary in the tested common signed-parity exchange carrier.
D_MERGED is scalar-inexact on 4x5-k4 with eight contradictions, so the two owner depth channels cannot be replaced solely by total positive/negative depth-change counts in the common carrier.
Adding only owner-swap-invariant sign-specific imbalance magnitudes |D0+-D1+| and |D0--D1-| repairs the merged carrier on 4x5-k4 while keeping owner identity removed.

D_UNORDERED_CHANNELS is exact but is not the first passing frozen rung; preserving the two complete unlabeled owner vectors is therefore unnecessary relative to the coarser symmetric-marginal carrier.
On 4x5-k4 the symmetric owner quotient reduces structural image rank from 262 to 254 with no scalar loss, exposing eight owner-label/pairing directions that are value-null.

The current preferred common exchange representation is a small owner-symmetric bucket carrier: C+,C-, D+,D-, A+,A-, where D are total odd-magnitude depth-change counts and A are owner-swap-invariant imbalance magnitudes.
